test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 02 May 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate choice.

His intent was to become sole lord and to _____ his tiny principality.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Aggrandize'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate choice to fill in the blank is** "aggrandize."**
 
• "**Aggrandize"** means to increase the power, status, or wealth of something or someone.(किसी चीज़ या किसी व्यक्ति की शक्ति, स्थिति या धन को बढ़ाना)
 
• The **sentence states **that his intention is to become the sole lord and increase the power, status, or wealth of his small principality.(वाक्य से पता चलता है कि उसका इरादा एकमात्र स्वामी बनना और अपनी छोटी रियासत की शक्ति, स्थिति या धन को बढ़ाना है)

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is:* *'His intent was to become sole lord and to** aggrandize** his tiny principality.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **"Subsidize"** means to support an organization or activity financially.(किसी संगठन या गतिविधि को आर्थिक रूप से समर्थन देना)
 
• **"Jeopardize" **means to put something or someone into a situation in which there is a risk of harm, loss, or danger.(किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति को ऐसी स्थिति में डालना जिसमे नुकसान होने का ख़तरा हो)
 
• **"Methodize" **means to arrange something according to a systematic or established form of procedure.(किसी चीज़ को व्यवस्थित प्रक्रिया के अनुसार व्यवस्थित करना)
